zh: 昨晚我们家停电停了两个小时。
en: We had a {power cut|power outage|blackout} for two hours last night.

zh: 洗衣机又坏了。
en: The {washing machine|washer} has broken down again.

zh: 我们在客厅看电视。
en: We watch TV in the {living room|lounge|sitting room}.

zh: 垃圾桶满了，你能倒一下吗？
en: The {rubbish bin|bin|trash can|garbage can} is full. Could you empty it?

zh: 冬天我们整天开着热泵（冷暖空调）。
en: We leave the {heat pump} on all day in winter.

zh: 今年冬天我们的电费账单特别高。
en: Our {power bill|electricity bill} was really high this winter.

zh: 物业经理下周要来做房屋检查。
en: The property manager is doing a {house inspection|flat inspection|property inspection|rental inspection} next week.

zh: 我烤面包的时候烟雾报警器响了。
en: The {smoke alarm|smoke detector} went off when I was making toast.

zh: 出门的时候记得锁前门。
en: Remember to lock the {front door} when you leave.

zh: 你来的时候可以住我们的空房间。
en: You can stay in our {spare room|spare bedroom|guest room} when you visit.

zh: 洗洁精用完了。
en: We've run out of {dishwashing liquid|washing-up liquid|washing up liquid|dish soap}.

zh: 房东通知我们要涨房租。
en: The landlord has told us there's going to be a {rent increase|rent rise}.

zh: 这房子装了双层玻璃，所以冬天很暖和。
en: The house has {double glazing}, so it stays warm in winter.

zh: 热水罐漏水了，我们已经叫了水管工。
en: The {hot water cylinder|hot water tank|water heater} is leaking, so we've called a plumber.

zh: 我们轮流做家务。
en: We take turns doing the {household chores|chores|housework}.

zh: 隔壁邻居昨晚开派对，吵得很。
en: Our {next-door neighbours|next-door neighbors|next door neighbours|next door neighbors} had a noisy party last night.

zh: 签字之前请仔细阅读租房协议。
en: Read the {tenancy agreement|rental agreement|lease agreement|lease} carefully before you sign it.

zh: 厨房的灯泡烧坏了。
en: The {light bulb|lightbulb|bulb} in the kitchen has blown.

zh: 插座太远了，我们需要一根延长线。
en: The socket is too far away, so we need an {extension cord|extension lead|extension cable}.

zh: 我们周日去看了三场房屋开放日。
en: We went to three {open homes|open houses} on Sunday.

zh: 吸尘器在走廊的柜子里。
en: The {vacuum cleaner|vacuum|hoover} is in the hall cupboard.

zh: 我们一家人围着餐桌吃晚饭。
en: The whole family sat around the {dining table|dinner table} for tea.

zh: 塑料瓶要扔进回收桶。
en: Plastic bottles go in the {recycling bin}.

zh: 今天天气好，我把洗好的衣服挂在晾衣绳上了。
en: It's a nice day, so I've hung the washing on the {washing line|clothesline|clothes line}.

zh: 用擦碗布把盘子擦干。
en: Dry the plates with a {tea towel|dish towel}.

zh: 冬天我睡觉时会带一个热水袋。
en: I take a {hot water bottle|hot-water bottle} to bed in winter.

zh: 我在邻居那里留了一把备用钥匙。
en: I've left a {spare key} with my neighbour.

zh: 浴室里滴水的水龙头吵得我一夜没睡。
en: The {dripping tap|leaking tap|leaky tap|dripping faucet|leaking faucet|leaky faucet} in the bathroom kept me awake all night.

zh: 割草机放在花园的工具棚里。
en: The lawnmower is kept in the {garden shed|shed|tool shed|toolshed}.

zh: 我把手机放在床头柜上充电。
en: I charge my phone on the {bedside table|bedside cabinet|nightstand}.
